metadata.description: A marketplace of Claude Code plugins — atomic skills and an opinionated multi-agent feature workflow.

plugins.name: skills-core
plugins.description: Atomic, framework-free Claude Code skills (brainstorm, day-in-review, create-skill, scaffold-skill-marketplace, setup-feature-branch, example-tool-skill). Installs a single skill-recommender hook and nothing else.

plugins.name: feature-builder
plugins.description: Multi-agent feature-development workflow: workflow-build-feature + generate-project-context, backed by 8 specialized subagents, workflow-enforcement hooks, and stack templates. Opt in only if you want the orchestrated build loop.
